parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the Port Trigger

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Indicates the owner of the {{object}} instance. Note: This parameter was changed to writeOnceReadOnly in the Device:2.18 version.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description associated with this {{object}} entry.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: Specifies the incoming L3 interface to which this port trigger applies. Typically this will be the LAN interface.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Trigger Port, the port number which is used to start the port trigger rule.

parameters.name: PortEndRange
parameters.description: Indicates the last port of the port range that starts with {{param|Port}} which is used to start the port trigger rule. A value of zero (0) indicates that no port range is specified, i.e. that the range consists only of {{param|Port}}. If {{param|Port}} is zero, the value of this parameter MUST be ignored. If specified, the value of this parameter MUST be greater than or equal to the value of {{param|Port}}.

parameters.name: AutoDisableDuration
parameters.description: Number of {{units}} the port trigger MUST be active. When the {{param}} is expired new connections are no longer allowed, active connections SHOULD not be terminated.

parameters.name: ActivationDate
parameters.description: Indicates when the port trigger was enabled. When the port trigger is no longer active. Note: This parameter was demoted to readOnly in the Device:2.18 version.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the trigger port.

parameters.name: ScheduleRef
parameters.description: Each reference provides a schedule where time based access can be enabled. When {{param}} is {{empty}} the {{object}} is not scheduled, and the {{param|Enable}} defines the operational state.

parameters.name: Log
parameters.description: Enable or disable logging, in a {{object|.DeviceInfo.VendorLogFile}}, of packets matching this {{object}}.

parameters.name: LogRef
parameters.description: Specifies the logging rules for this {{object}} entry. The {{param|Log}} parameter MUST be set to {{true}} for this setting to take effect. When {{param|Log}} is {{true}} and {{param}} is {{empty}} or contains an invalid reference, the system MUST treat the configuration as an error and set {{param|Status}} to {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.
